body: `getFormValue` now relies on `input.form === formElement` to decide whether a checked radio participates in the surrounding `<Form>` (mirroring successful-control semantics). The new tests cover the "associated with another form" case, but there isn’t a regression test for the other important branch: a context-portaled radio whose `input.form` is `null` and has no `form` attribute should be omitted (and included only when explicitly associated via `form="<current id>"`), as CheckboxGroup already asserts. Adding those tests would help prevent future changes from accidentally widening this condition and reintroducing incorrect submissions.
